units.text: New physics contributions to anomalous couplings and top-quark decay New physics contributions to anomalous couplings and top-quark decay
Introduction

The charge parity (C )-violation phenomenon that was first observed in neutral-kaon decay [1] needs to be explored beyond the Standard-Model (SM) as SM only provides a small amount of C -violation via the CKM-matrices [2] which is not sufficient to explain the matter-antimatter asymmetry of the Universe [3]. The aim of this present article is to investigate the C -violating effects of the anomalous vertex and provide stringent constraints on anomalous couplings using the measurements of top-quark decay width and cross-section as well as production asymmetries. Anomalous interactions in top-quark production and decay have been widely explored in the previous literature [4].

Conclusions

In this study, we have explored the C -violating effects of the anomalous vertex in the context of top-quark via its decay into a b-quark and a W-boson. An estimate of the constraints on the anomalous couplings and have been presented using top-quark decay width and cross-section measurements as well as production asymmetries.
